core_obligations: Reduce to an affine ring map A -> B with B Noetherian (proof lines 847-851).
Translate associated points into associated primes of M and get the first inclusion (proof lines 852-858).
Insert the two weakly-associated inclusions (proof lines 859-866).
Use equality of the outer sets to conclude (proof lines 867-868).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an affine morphism f : X -> S with X locally Noetherian and a quasi-coherent F on X, the four sets f(Ass_X(F)), Ass_S(f_*F), WeakAss_S(f_*F) and f(WeakAss_X(F)) are equal (source lines 834-845). The proof reduces to ring maps A -> B with B Noetherian, identifies the associated points of F with the associated primes of the module M, observes that an A-associated prime of M is an associated point of f_*F, and then chains the three inclusions supplied by the algebra lemma and the two weakly-associated lemmas, the outer sets being equal by the previous lemma.
